description: Backend controller for user authentication and account management, including signup, login, logout, user retrieval, update, password reset, and account activation.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation, password hashing, user creation, email confirmation, and automatic login.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, issues JWT token, and sets authentication cookie.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication cookie to log out the user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user details based on authenticated user ID.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user profile information, including password if provided.

methods.name: getResetToken
methods.description: Generates password reset token, saves it, and sends reset email.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user password using provided reset token and logs in user automatically.

methods.name: activateAccount
methods.description: Activates user account using activation token.
